title: 3729. Count Distinct Subarrays Divisible by K in Sorted Array

examples.explanation: The good subarrays are [1, 2], [3], and [1, 2, 3]. For example, [1, 2, 3] is good because the sum of its elements is 1 + 2 + 3 = 6, and 6 % k = 6 % 3 = 0.

The good subarrays are [2, 2, 2] and [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]. For example, [2, 2, 2] is good because the sum of its elements is 2 + 2 + 2 = 6, and 6 % k = 6 % 6 = 0. Note that [2, 2, 2] is counted only once.
